month.headline: Taiwan shuts Papua New Guinea office and ends LNG buying, citing Chinese pressure
month.summary: Taiwan has closed its office in Papua New Guinea, cut all aid and halted LNG purchases, citing Chinese pressure. The move follows Papua New Guinea's closure of Taiwan's mission in Port Moresby less than four months earlier.
